title: Feature request: tracking how many times you complete a goal/log something specific over a period
body: I love Finch, it’s so helpful for tracking my goals in a fun way and reflecting/personal growth. I wish though that there were a way to view goal in isolation and see how many times/ what percent you completed it over a certain period (ex: X completed Y goal 60% of days over the last year. This is up 24% YoY).  I feel like in general it’s hard to track long term progress/review over the long term. I’d really appreciate a feature that would allow me to do so, so that I can see how I’m reaching each of my goals, or also check things like how often I’ve logged X emotion over the course of time, etc. Anyway thanks for the great app and would super appreciate this feature!!

title: セルフケアに意識が向くようになりました🐣
body:
インストールして3ヶ月、plusプランに入って1ヶ月くらい経ちました。
メンタルがかなり落ち込んでいたときに始めて、ずっと寄り添ってもらっています。「ベッドから出る」「水を飲む」など日常の細かいタスクをたくさん設定できて、達成感と心地よさがあります。
最初から自分で全部考えなくてもプリセットがありますし、続けていくうちに「これは毎日できてるな」という日常的な作業や家事を追加していって、徐々にたくさんレインボーストーンを集められるようになります💎
他にもストレッチのメニューや呼吸法のメニューなど、たくさんパターンがあるので開かずに続けられそうです。なによりFinchがかわいい🐣👶🏻

It’s been about three months since I started using the app, and about a month since I joined the Plus plan.
I first downloaded it when I was feeling really down, and it’s been such a comforting companion ever since.
I love how I can set small, everyday tasks like “get out of bed” or “drink water” — checking them off gives me a real sense of accomplishment and comfort.
There are presets from the start, so you don’t have to come up with everything yourself, and as you keep going, you naturally start adding more daily habits and chores that you’re already doing. That way, you gradually earn more and more rainbow stones.
There are also lots of options for stretching routines, breathing exercises, and other calming activities, so it feels easy to keep using it without pressure.
And most of all — Finch is just so cute.
